description: Create a fresh email address that can receive real email. Call this before you type an email address into a sign-up, login, password-reset or newsletter form, so you can read the verification code or link that gets sent. Returns { address, since }. Keep `since` and pass it to wait_for_email: it makes sure you only get mail that arrived after this inbox was created. Use a new inbox per task; addresses cost nothing until mail arrives.

prefix.description: Optional readable start of the address, e.g. "signup". Random characters are appended so addresses never collide.

name: create_inbox
title: Create inbox
